CRGR.description: Concurrent Reaction Group (CRGR). A single global entry (key 1) whose GROUPS list selects the structure groups whose support reactions are combined concurrently for moving-load analysis.

GROUPS.description: Set of structure group names whose reactions are treated as concurrent. Each entry must match an existing structure group name (validated at runtime; an unknown name is rejected). On PUT the previously selected set is fully replaced by this list.
